mode.title: Platform
mode.description: Which platform the URL(s) below belong to.

url.title: Community URL
url.description: A single community URL or bare slug, e.g. "https://www.skool.com/skool-100" or "skool-100" (Skool mode), or "https://whop.com/kaizen" or "kaizen" (Whop mode).

urls.title: Community URLs
urls.description: Multiple community URLs/slugs to process in one run (same platform, per the selected mode).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many communities to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default. Recommended especially for Whop mode, which sits behind Cloudflare Bot Management -- see the actor's README for details.
